d: Abdul El-Sayed’s sharp comeback aimed at US President Donald Trump is going viral following his historic election win. Responding to Trump’s remarks about getting a 'special metal detector', El-Sayed turned the challenge around with a pointed reply: “I'll take a metal detector test when you take a lie detector test.” The exchange has drawn attention online, putting El-Sayed’s response in the spotlight after his electoral victory. His remark takes aim at Trump while turning the metal detector challenge into a direct political counterattack. The viral moment has added another talking point…
